items.title: Earl King Interview, 1980-04-10
items.q: So I got to know Huey and he had a little group, he and a gentleman called Willie Netters, a drummer, and they had this little group and they needed a singer.

ctx.x: to turn from church to playing what's not a second music and playing guitar or some other

instrument? Well, my playing and performing was kind of a coincidence, you know, like I was looking for work one time and I couldn't find anything to do. So I started listening around and listening to groups of people like Huey Smith, which later became Huey Smith and Clowns, which was a pianist that used to play for a lot of talent that would audition for record companies. So I got to know Huey and he had a little group, he and a gentleman called Willie Netters, a drummer, and they had this little group and they…
But, uh, what was the first song that you learned on the guitar? Could you show it to us?
